description: The master of a melody chain: what the voices beside it share, and the chart they are all played against. It makes no sound of its own

params.text: How hard the voices keep out of each other's way. A note colliding with one another voice has taken is weighted down; nought lets them collide freely
The seed the random generator every voice draws from starts at, 0 to 999. Added to the chart's own seed, so the same number always gives the same lines back
Records every note the voices choose to a file, with the odds each was chosen from and every change of setting. Lit while recording; never starts by itself when a patch is opened
How many phrases pass before the whole line comes round again. At four, the fifth phrase is the first one again. Set it to match mpxPhrase's own cycle and the rhythm and the pitches return together
Pressed, the seed above is used on its own and the chart's is ignored, so these lines stay as they are while the rest of the patch follows the chart

inputs.text: Takes the chart, which carries the key, the chords and the beat

notes: place one or more mpxVoice modules immediately to the right. Each draws one line: a bass, a melody or an inner voice.
while no voice is beside it the panel says so in amber, and the words go once one is added.
CHART IN must be patched. The key, the chords and the beat all come from there, and a rhythm source has none of them to pass on.
it holds no voice of its own, so that a patch wanting one bass line places one voice rather than a melody it has to ignore.
separation does nothing with a single voice. There is nothing to keep a line apart from.
